records.name: Amor Ringfrei
records.biography_en: Believes romance needs commitment and occasionally a sturdier prop. His folded HyperNorm chair waits beside the promise that love settles everything. A dissonant card asks whether commitment can make room instead of making a point. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Bindungsabsicht wurde mit einem belastbaren Möbel bekräftigt.

variant_notes.note_en: Believes romance needs commitment and occasionally a sturdier prop.

records.name: Herzbruchkind Fastheil
records.biography_en: Has repaired the keepsake more carefully than his account of what happened. His repaired HyperNorm heart survives every retelling except the one he gives himself. A dissonant card sits with the seam rather than asking it to disappear. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Reparatur ist vorbildlich. Der Bericht benötigt Nacharbeit.

variant_notes.note_en: Has repaired the keepsake more carefully than his account of what happened.

records.name: Briefpartnerin Beidseitig
records.biography_en: Knows both versions of the story and is beginning to miss the postage. Her HyperNorm letters contain two incompatible versions of the same evening. A dissonant card asks whether both writers might be lonely. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Beidseitigkeit wurde ordnungsgemäß getrennt zugestellt.

variant_notes.note_en: Knows both versions of the story and is beginning to miss the postage.

records.name: Exagent Rückblick
records.biography_en: Calls it closure because surveillance sounds less settled. His HyperNorm diary classifies watching as the final stage of letting go. A dissonant card asks what he could notice if he turned around. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Abschluss verlangt weiterhin regelmäßige Beobachtung.

variant_notes.note_en: Calls it closure because surveillance sounds less settled.

records.name: Tortenhüterin Fürimmerfast
records.biography_en: Has agreed to forever and would now like to know who is washing the plate. Her HyperNorm cake celebrates a future already agreed by the decoration. A dissonant card asks who will still be heard after the last slice. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Ewigkeit lässt eine kurze Rückfrage zur Küchenarbeit zu.

variant_notes.note_en: Has agreed to forever and would now like to know who is washing the plate.

records.name: Rückpraller Wiederda
records.biography_en: Returns to the conversation before the previous impact has been discussed. His HyperNorm ball returns before the last impact has acquired a name. A dissonant card suggests a pause that is not another departure. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Rückkehr erfolgte vor Abschluss der vorherigen Berührung.

variant_notes.note_en: Returns to the conversation before the previous impact has been discussed.
